definitions.explanation: A pharmacist's call or message to the prescribing doctor to check a prescription that looks doubtful, for example a wrong dose, a duplicate drug or a dangerous combination. Japanese law requires the pharmacist to make it before filling such a prescription.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬局|やっきょく}→薬局：01069_yakkyoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{疑義照会|ぎぎしょうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The pharmacy made a prescription inquiry.

examples.japanese: {疑義照会|ぎぎしょうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧、⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: After the pharmacist checked with the doctor, the dose was changed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{処方箋|しょほうせん}→処方箋：06496_shohousen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飲|の}み{合|あ}わせ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{薬剤師|やくざいし}→薬剤師：07030_yakuzaishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{疑義照会|ぎぎしょうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Because the prescription included drugs that interact badly, the pharmacist sent an inquiry to the hospital.

notes:
Made of ⟦{疑義|ぎぎ}→疑義：32428_gigi⟧ (doubt, question) + ⟦{照会|しょうかい}→照会：16171_shoukai⟧ (inquiry). A technical word of pharmacies and hospitals; patients meet it when the pharmacist says they must check with the doctor first, which can mean a wait at the counter.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {疑義照会|ぎぎしょうかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ / ⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to make a prescription inquiry
- {疑義照会|ぎぎしょうかい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧: as a result of the inquiry
- ⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧{医|い}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{疑義照会|ぎぎしょうかい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to query the prescribing doctor
